look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_08 voice-over, 50.1 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone. Sathya’s animated GIF stickers play as 6-frame sprite loops picked from t. Logo slots: plain cream cards that hold perfectly still in the foreground, for Sathya to lay official logos over in their editor.

scenes.name: Sledgehammer
scenes.desc: Frame 0 mid-swing: a sledgehammer comes down on a walnut; Fable 5.2 just dropped; a white glove catches it: not for everything.

scenes.name: One model
scenes.desc: Most people pick one model: a paper model list stuck on one row, never switch; a still Claude logo slot; costing you speed, usage limits and quality (stopwatch, empty gauge, cracked loupe).

scenes.name: Haiku
scenes.desc: Haiku = quick tasks: a pocket knife flicks open; rewrite a text, sort a list, pull details tick off; a hummingbird: fast answers, zero overthinking.

scenes.name: Daily drivers
scenes.desc: Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5: a daily-driver car rolls in; writing, research, coding; unsure? start with Opus; free plan? start with Sonnet.

scenes.name: Heavy lifter
scenes.desc: Fable 5.2 with a still launch-clip slot; a tower crane for long multi-step projects, messy yarn, big codebases, deep analysis; a car stuck in the tangle; priciest on your usage: a fuel pump and $$$; don’t waste it.

scenes.name: Start small
scenes.desc: Rule of thumb: a ladder with the knife, drill and crane on its rungs, start small, move up; save this: the three tools recapped as Haiku, Sonnet / Opus and Fable.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
